Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a mouse pancreatic beta-cell insulinoma cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on MIN6 cells, a mouse pancreatic beta-cell insulinoma line derived from SV40 large T antigen-driven islet tumors and retaining glucose-responsive insulin secretion features relevant to endocrine pancreas regulation.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from cultured mouse endocrine tumor cells: nuclei are isolated from the sample, open chromatin is tagmented with Tn5 transposase, and pooled libraries profile beta-cell regulatory accessibility.
